clinical_context: HIV antiretroviral (now largely replaced by newer agents)
system_prompt: You are a senior medicinal chemist specializing in prodrug design and ADMET optimization. Always respond with valid JSON containing a 'modifications' list. Each modification must include 'description', 'smiles', and 'rationale' fields.

modifications.description: Introduce a phosphate ester prodrug group on the hydroxyl group to enhance solubility and improve oral bioavailability.
modifications.rationale: The addition of a phosphate ester group increases aqueous solubility, thereby improving absorption in the gastrointestinal tract. This group can be cleaved enzymatically in vivo to regenerate the active drug.

modifications.description: Add a valine ester prodrug moiety to the hydroxyl group to enhance membrane permeability and improve oral absorption.
modifications.rationale: The valine ester prodrug approach enhances passive diffusion across cell membranes, improving absorption. Valine esters are recognized by intestinal peptide transporters, further boosting bioavailability, and the ester can be cleaved enzymatically to release the active drug.

modifications.description: Incorporate a carbonate prodrug group on the hydroxyl to improve chemical stability and systemic delivery.
modifications.rationale: The carbonate prodrug improves the chemical stability of the hydroxyl group and provides a controlled release mechanism. This modification enhances systemic delivery while ensuring the active drug is regenerated in vivo.
